cc:Work.dc:title: Reliability, test window (development set)
cc:Work.dc:description: Reliability diagram. Source: MLflow experiment readmission-risk-v1, runs logistic_regression=fe9633ca42384ea5aeaba83e13d65701, xgboost_calibrated=abe9c605509b49dda4d8ba0aef511a60; 1539 test rows, 41 positives; 10 quantile bins; 95% Wilson intervals with rows treated as independent (indicative only); development-set quality, not a virgin holdout.
